headline: Over 300k rounds fired: Police reform remains stalled despite July uprising
summary: Despite a commission's recommendations for a more accountable force, structural and cultural issues continue to hinder police reform in Bangladesh.
details: A report from the International Crimes Tribunal-1 reveals that 305,311 rounds of ammunition were fired nationwide and 95,313 rounds in Dhaka alone during the July uprising. Most of the 843 deaths recorded in the government gazette were caused by these shots.
caption:
305,311 rounds of ammunition fired nationwide. Why is police reform still stalled in Bangladesh?

A report from the International Crimes Tribunal-1 reveals that 305,311 rounds of ammunition were fired nationwide and 95,313 rounds in Dhaka alone during the July uprising. Most of the 843 deaths recorded in the government gazette were caused by these shots.

#Bangladesh #PoliceReform #JulyUprising #HumanRights #Accountability

Source: Prothom Alo

headline_marked: PM [[appeals for public help]] to keep Bangladesh clean and litter-free
headline: PM appeals for public help to keep Bangladesh clean and litter-free
summary: The Prime Minister has called upon citizens to take an active role in maintaining cleanliness across the country.
details: The Prime Minister of Bangladesh has issued a public appeal for citizens to help keep the country clean and litter-free.
He emphasized the importance of community participation in maintaining a healthy and sustainable environment.
The appeal focuses on reducing littering and promoting better waste management practices across the nation.
Citizens are encouraged to take individual responsibility for their surroundings to ensure a cleaner Bangladesh.
caption:
A cleaner Bangladesh starts with you. The Prime Minister calls for public action against littering.

The Prime Minister of Bangladesh has issued a public appeal for citizens to help keep the country clean and litter-free.

He emphasized the importance of community participation in maintaining a healthy and sustainable environment.

The appeal focuses on reducing littering and promoting better waste management practices across the nation.

Citizens are encouraged to take individual responsibility for their surroundings to ensure a cleaner Bangladesh.

#Bangladesh #CleanBangladesh #PublicAppeal #Environment #WasteManagement

Source: Dhaka Tribune
